title: The weekly digest reports the ops sidecar
goal: querylog.py digest prints one ops block per week from the committed ops sidecars (land, gate and test-run times, refused dones, agent runs, and the call census once it exists); a second digest on unchanged inputs prints the same lines.
notes: Narrowed in the 2026-10-05 backlog review: the kblog.py propose run left the goal, since its check (kblog_propose_converges) already passed and a dry run over the committed store would propose 6608 rows, mostly the retired fleet's land runs; that run is ST-mbnahtlc's sibling story with its own gate on the window and events.
